Esports Helper 0.1.3 restores support for playoff match cards.

- Restore game colors for tournament matches, including the complete mobile card.
- Recognize playoff cards for optional new-tab buttons, Ctrl/Cmd-click, and middle-click.
- Recognize tournament match days when reversing Past matches.
- Preserve saved preferences; new-tab controls remain off by default.

Validation: JavaScript syntax, manifest and asset checks, and Chromium tests using a saved page and simulated match data. Live-site navigation was not verified.

[Get the Esports Helper extension!](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ijoihdmdnameopfehjlbcjlbpmebknfe)

The attached ZIP contains runtime files only. Publishing this GitHub release does not submit or publish a Chrome Web Store update.
